# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Verified the pending shrimp-loop runtime amendments were already present in the current workspace, then tightened the regression coverage around them. I updated `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs` unit tests to lock in oxygen-limited respiration routing and same-day carbonate-cache refresh before condition updates, and adjusted `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_tracking.rs` plus `crates/tank_core/tests/thermal_reproduction_penalty.rs` to seed `animal.reserve_g` explicitly so the suite remains consistent with reserve-only hatching and maturation.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the four pending amendments against the current runtime and confirmed the production-path fixes were already present, leaving regression and fixture alignment as the remaining work in this turn.
2. [Completed] Updated shrimp pathway tests to cover oxygen-limited respiration coupling and stale-carbonate-cache refresh behavior, and aligned reproduction fixtures with the reserve-only biomass funding rule.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting plus targeted and full `tank_core` test passes to confirm the amended shrimp-loop behavior and fixture changes are green end to end.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib --test shrimp_population --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test thermal_reproduction_penalty` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- The untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory is still present in the worktree and was left untouched.
